title: Precision probe harness for embeddings with timebound goldens
creator: Maya Patel
description:
Motivation: We need a compact, reproducible harness that combines curated golden query-answer pairs (timebound snapshots) with synthetic perturbations and scaling probes to measure embedding accuracy, reranker fidelity, and regression/directional drift over time. Current nightly jobs focus on generic aggregate stats; this ticket builds a precision probe that: (1) stores weekly 'golden' shards tied to production traffic windows (timebound goldens) so we can detect temporal model degradation, (2) runs offline recall/MAP/MRR evaluation plus embedding stability tests, and (3) executes scaling probes that simulate bursty QPS for both embeddings and reranking paths to measure latency and resource behavior.

Scope: - Author a canonical golden set format for timebound snapshots (CSV/ndjson with metadata: snapshot_time, dataset_tag, owner, labels, human_verified boolean). - Implement a nightly job that samples production traffic to produce/refresh weekly goldens and uploads them to the evaluation bucket. - Build offline runner that computes MAP@k, Recall@k, MRR, calibrated cosine drift score, embedding stability (cosine std over reruns), cluster-purity change, and population-level distributional shifts (KS test and Wasserstein). - Integrate synthetic perturbation suite (typos, paraphrase, entity-swap, long-tail truncation) for robustness probes. - Add scaling probes to the runner: progressive QPS ramp for embed-only and embed+rerank flows with telemetry collection (GPU % utilization, GPU memory, RPC latencies, batch sizes). - Wire alerts: both quality regressions (e.g., MAP drop > 3% absolute or directional drift > threshold) and resource anomalies (p95 latency exceed SLO or batch-size collapse). - Expose results in a Grafana dashboard and persist evaluation history for 180 days.

Non-goals: - Human re-labeling tool (we'll link to existing labeling flow), - Full A/B launch automation (this is an eval harness only).
acceptance_criteria: Canonical golden set schema documented in Confluence with examples and ownership fields
Nightly job publishes a new timebound golden shard to s3://redwood-eval/goldens/YYYY-WW/<tag>.ndjson with checksum and manifest
Offline runner produces MAP@1/5/10, Recall@1/5/10, MRR, cosine-drift, embedding-stability and writes results to metrics and a historical store
Synthetic perturbation suite runs as part of nightly eval and flags tests that fall below thresholds
Scaling probe reproducibly ramps to target QPS and captures resource telemetry (GPU util, mem, per-request latency) stored under /eval/scaling/<date>/
Grafana dashboard shows last 90 days of key metrics and has at least two alert rules: quality-regression and latency-breach
Playbook for responding to alerts written and linked in Confluence
implementation_plan: Week 1: Define golden schema, add sampling job to capture production queries (sampling @1% traffic, redaction), and create upload pipeline
Week 2: Implement offline runner prototype and compute baseline metrics for last 8 weeks of archived traffic
Week 3: Add synthetic perturbation transforms and implement embedding stability reruns (3 seeds per item)
Week 4: Build scaling probe runner (kubernetes job) with step-ramp generator and telemetry exporter
Week 5: Hook runner outputs to metrics backend, create Grafana dashboards and alert rules, run smoke validation
Week 6: Documentation, ownership handoff, and runbook review with SRE and PM
metrics: Cosine-drift score (mean pairwise cosine delta vs baseline golden snapshot)
Embedding stability (stddev of repeated embeddings per item)
Latency p50/p95 for embed-only and embed+rerank flows under probe
GPU utilization and memory pressure during scaling probes
Cost per 1k evaluated tokens/queries for offline runs
monitoring_setup: Grafana dashboard: embeddings.precision_probe (panels: MAP trends, recall, drift score, stability, latency heatmap)
Alert: embeddings.quality.regression -> PagerDuty (trigger if MAP@5 drops by >=3% absolute or drift score > 0.15)
Alert: embeddings.latency.breach -> Slack + PagerDuty (p95 > SLO for two consecutive probes)
Daily summary email with top 5 failing perturbation tests and resource anomalies
updates: 2026-02-16 — Kickoff: agreed on weekly timebound goldens instead of monthly to capture diurnal/product-seasonal effects (notes in Confluence). Maya assigned sampling job work.
2026-02-20 — Prototype runner completed (embeddings computed against last 4 weeks of archived traffic). Baseline MAP@5 computed for candidate models; stored under /eval/baseline/2026-02-20/.

2026-02-26 — Design review with PM and SRE: accepted scaling probe approach (k8s Job ramp, GPU metrics via node-exporter + nvidia-smi exporter). Action: add rate-limiter to avoid noisy-production impact.
2026-03-03 — Synthetic perturbation module added: typographer, paraphrase via small T5, entity-swapper. Initial runs show paraphrase has greatest impact on MAP (avg drop 4.2% vs baseline).
2026-03-09 — First full nightly run succeeded; artifacts uploaded to s3 and metrics pushed. Notable: one perturbation test failed threshold — added ticket ENG-146981 to investigate reranker tuning.
2026-03-12 — Integrated Grafana panels and initial alert rules. Running a dry-run of scaling probe to validate resource telemetry collection planned for 2026-03-14.
